title: GOOD: LMDB PathGuard RAII for single-open invariant enforcement
description: crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs uses a PathGuard RAII type that inserts the canonical path into the global OPEN_PATHS set on construction and removes it on drop. This correctly enforces LMDB single-env-per-path constraint across all early-return paths including error cases. Correct use of RAII; no change needed.
